title: Inter press scorecard — the papers went 2 for 14 this week
description:
Fourteen claims about Inter in the Italian press this week. Two came true, one was plain wrong.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=47

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

DENIED — Gazzetta dello Sport had Carlos Augusto in line to start at Bologna and Benjamin Pavard back in defense (via FCInterNews, Oct 15). Carlos Augusto came off the bench and scored; Inter said Pavard had an adductor strain.
CONFIRMED — Gazzetta dello Sport put Lautaro Martinez out for five to six weeks (via FCInter1908, Oct 16). Chivu then said he returns after the November break (Inter.it, Oct 16).
REPORTED — Gazzetta dello Sport puts AC Milan in front in the race for Nicolo Tresoldi, whose valuation has passed 50 million euros (via FCInterNews, Oct 17). Inter have said nothing.

The week of Oct 12-18: 14 reported claims, 2 confirmed, 1 denied, 11 still open.

Next up: Inter vs Shakhtar Donetsk, Wed Oct 21, Champions League matchday 3 - 3:00 PM ET / 21:00 CEST / Paramount+ and ViX.
